window: Editorial assessment 19 Nov 08:52:59–20 Nov 08:52:59 America/Chicago. Ukrainian Air Force preliminary attack window 19 Nov 18:00–20 Nov 10:30 Kyiv time; Russian MoD overnight claim 19–20 Nov (exact start/end not independently confirmed). Distinct windows; do not add as synchronized totals.
reporting_side: Ukrainian Air Force preliminary official claims reported by Ukrainska Pravda/Ukrinform; Russian Defense Ministry claims relayed by Interfax; Reuters and Financial Times report civilian effects citing local authorities; Polish defense officials' airspace claims reported by Reuters.
notes: PRELIMINARY / ATTRIBUTED, NOT VERIFIED AIRCRAFT TRACKS. Ukrainian Air Force reports 404 drones launched (123 jet-powered), 84 cruise missiles and an unspecified number of ballistic/anti-ship missiles; total missile launch count unavailable/null. Reports 380 drones and 82 missiles neutralized/suppressed (79 cruise, 3 ballistic/anti-ship), 23 impact locations and 10 debris locations as of 10:30 Kyiv. Russian Defense Ministry claims 310 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones intercepted overnight, independently unverified. Reuters reports eight killed in Ukraine (six Kyiv, two Lviv), with casualties based on Ukrainian officials; Kyiv bridge damage and water/power disruption; regional impact details provisional. Polish defense officials report three airspace violations, including likely missiles and drone; Reuters reports Rzeszow airport air-traffic-controller evacuation. Russian Smolensk governor reports industrial/energy/home damage with no casualties; Kursk governor reports injuries in a potentially differing 24h window, not merged. No independently verified aircraft losses. Earlier Russian record claim 1,336 from 16–17 Nov is excluded. Avoid summing official tallies across mismatched windows.
